items.classified_item_description: Item made classified by Bungie, but known to the community. It has been restored from cross-referenced external sources.
items.censored_item_description: Item whose name and details have been censored in the API.
items.beta_item_description: Duplicate item historically used for pre-release testing. Its original visual has now been restored using cross-referenced sources.
items.replaced_item_description: Item replaced by another item in the API. It has the same hash as the current item. Original visual restored from cross-referenced external sources.
items.secret_item_description: Item that has been directly set as classified in the API. Only its references remain. No information is available at this time.
